title: Schedule of Booking Service Fee, Hold, Void and Free Change Windows — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
The agency service fee charged for each traveller when the ticket is issued, the period an unticketed hold may stand before it is released, the period after ticket issue in which the ticket may be voided at no cost, and the period after ticket issue in which an itinerary change carries no change fee are each fixed by the fare brand held. The following schedule states those quantities for the seven brands sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands.

| Fare brand | Agency service fee for each traveller, USD | Hold period before release, hours | Void at no cost after issue, hours | Change at no change fee after issue, hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 34.95 | 0 | 24 | 0 |
| Economy Saver | 29.95 | 0 | 24 | 0 |
| Economy Classic | 24.95 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Economy Flex | 19.95 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Premium Economy Select | 14.95 | 48 | 24 | 48 |
| Business Saver | 9.95 | 48 | 24 | 48 |
| Business Flex | 0.00 | 72 | 24 | 72 |

Annotations to the schedule.

1. The service fee line is charged for each traveller on the booking and not once for the booking. A booking for three travellers held under Economy Classic therefore carries the fee of 24.95 for each of the three (a hypothetical illustration).

2. A hold period stated as 0 hours is no hold at all: under Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver an unticketed hold does not stand. The longest hold on the schedule is the 72 hours of Business Flex.

3. The void line is the same 24 hours for every one of the seven brands, counted from the issue of the ticket, and is the only line in the schedule that does not vary by brand.

4. A free change period stated as 0 hours is no such period: under Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver there is no period after issue in which an itinerary change carries no change fee. Under Premium Economy Select and Business Saver that period is the stated 48 hours from issue, and under Business Flex it is 72 hours.

5. The only brand whose booking service fee is 0.00 is Business Flex; the fee falls in the order of the brands from the 34.95 of Basic Economy Lite to the 19.95 of Economy Flex and the 9.95 of Business Saver.
